advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Consider restricting `require_file_impact_scope` values to the known `file_impact_scope` enum (undeclared/paths/none) so an invalid scope fails loudly at validation instead of silently never routing.
evidence: overlay.py:227-231: `not isinstance(scope_requirement, list) or not scope_requirement or any(not isinstance(value, str) or not value for value in scope_requirement)` — only checks non-empty strings, not enum membership
The persisted vocabulary is closed: `_mcp_models.py:117: file_impact_scope: Literal["undeclared", "paths", "none"]`
registry.py:410: `if required_file_impact_scopes and file_impact_scope not in required_file_impact_scopes` — an out-of-enum scope simply never matches, silently
advisory.finding: The `require_file_impact_scope` validator accepts ANY non-empty string list (e.g. `["banana"]`), not restricted to the valid `file_impact_scope` enum (`undeclared`/`paths`/`none`). A criterion configured with a scope value that can never be persisted will silently never route, with no error at load time.
